description: ZENITHFORGE is an innovation-driven team participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Our project, “Flame in Freefall,” explores microgravity combustion data to develop AI-powered insights for improving fire safety in space. We are passionate about space science, artificial intelligence, data analysis, and technology. We welcome enthusiastic teammates skilled in AI/ML, coding, data visualization, web development, space science, and research who want to build impactful solutions together.
